package ssa

import (
	"IMPORT_ABI"
	IMPORT_BASE
	"IMPORT_IR"
	"IMPORT_OBJ"
	"IMPORT_SRC"
	"IMPORT_SYS"
	"IMPORT_TYPECHECK"
	"IMPORT_TYPES"
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

type snapshotDiagnosticFrontend struct {
	Frontend
	enabled bool
	log     bytes.Buffer
	fatal   string
}

func (f *snapshotDiagnosticFrontend) Log() bool { return f.enabled }
func (f *snapshotDiagnosticFrontend) Logf(format string, args ...any) {
	fmt.Fprintf(&f.log, format, args...)
}
func (f *snapshotDiagnosticFrontend) Fatalf(pos src.XPos, format string, args ...any) {
	f.fatal = fmt.Sprintf("%d:%s", pos.Line(), fmt.Sprintf(format, args...))
	panic(f.fatal)
}

type snapshotDiagnosticBuffer struct {
	bytes.Buffer
	closed bool
}

func (b *snapshotDiagnosticBuffer) Close() error { b.closed = true; return nil }

func TestSyncgoNativeSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	target := struct {
		arch  string
		size  int
		order binary.ByteOrder
	}{os.Getenv("SYNCGO_TARGET"), 8, binary.LittleEndian}
	switch target.arch {
	case "386":
		target.size = 4
	case "mips":
		target.size = 4
		target.order = binary.BigEndian
	case "ppc64":
		target.order = binary.BigEndian
	}
	SETUP
	ABI_SETUP
	DIAG_METADATA
	var out []string
	record := func(name, text string) { out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%x", name, sha256.Sum256([]byte(text)))) }
	fe := &snapshotDiagnosticFrontend{}
	cfg := &Config{PtrSize: int64(target.size), RegSize: int64(target.size), Types: *UP.NewTypes(), ctxt: LINK}
	cache := new(Cache)
	cache.Reset()
	f := cfg.NewFunc(fe, cache)
	f.Name = "format<&>"
	f.Type = TY.NewSignature(nil, nil, nil)
	f.ABISelf = ABI_NEW(0, 0, 0, 1)
	f.pass = &pass{name: "diagnostic phase"}
	entry, left, right, join, dead := f.NewBlock(BlockIf), f.NewBlock(BlockPlain), f.NewBlock(BlockPlain), f.NewBlock(BlockRet), f.NewBlock(BlockPlain)
	f.Entry = entry
	pos := LINK.PosTable.XPos(src.MakePos(src.NewFileBase("diagnostic.go", "diagnostic.go"), 17, 2)).WithIsStmt()
	for _, b := range f.Blocks {
		b.Pos = pos
	}
	entry.AddEdgeTo(left)
	entry.AddEdgeTo(right)
	left.AddEdgeTo(join)
	right.AddEdgeTo(join)
	dead.AddEdgeTo(join)
	a := entry.NewValue0I(pos, OpConst64, cfg.Types.Int64, 19)
	b := entry.NewValue0I(pos.WithNotStmt(), OpConst64, cfg.Types.Int64, -7)
	cond := entry.NewValue0I(pos, OpConstBool, cfg.Types.Bool, 1)
	entry.SetControl(cond)
	lv := left.NewValue2(pos, OpAdd64, cfg.Types.Int64, a, b)
	rv := right.NewValue2(pos, OpSub64, cfg.Types.Int64, a, b)
	dv := dead.NewValue0I(pos, OpConst64, cfg.Types.Int64, 99)
	phi := join.NewValue3(pos, OpPhi, cfg.Types.Int64, lv, rv, dv)
	join.SetControl(phi)
	left.NewValue0A(pos, OpStaticCall, TY.TypeMem, &AuxCall{Fn: &obj.LSym{Name: "callee"}})
	right.NewValue1(pos, OpNilCheck, TY.TypeMem, a)
	x := left.NewValue0(pos, OpCopy, cfg.Types.Int64)
	y := left.NewValue1(pos, OpCopy, cfg.Types.Int64, x)
	x.AddArg(y)
	name := GRAPH.NewNameAt(pos, TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("local"), cfg.Types.Int64)
	name.Class = ir.PAUTO
	name.SetFrameOffset(12)
	slot := &LocalSlot{N: name, Type: cfg.Types.Int64}
	f.Names = []*LocalSlot{slot}
	f.NamedValues[*slot] = []*Value{a, a}
	dump := func(label string) {
		reachable, live := findlive(f)
		out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("live:%s:%v:%v", label, reachable, live))
		f.Cache.freeBoolSlice(live)
		record(label+"-text", f.String())
		record(label+"-html", f.HTML("", nil))
		out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("hash:%s:%x:%s", label, hashFunc(f), f.rewriteHash()))
	}
	dump("initial")
	f.scheduled = true
	dump("scheduled")
	f.scheduled = false
	entry.Kind = BlockFirst
	dump("first")
	entry.Kind = BlockIf
	f.RegAlloc = make([]Location, f.NumValues())
	f.RegAlloc[a.ID] = &Register{name: "R<&>"}
	f.tempRegs = map[ID]*Register{a.ID: {name: "TMP"}}
	dump("allocated")
	f.RegAlloc = nil
	f.tempRegs = nil
	// Render one opcode of every Aux kind, using raw values to cover formatting,
	// not as a claim that these standalone instructions pass the SSA verifier.
	seen := map[auxType]bool{}
	for op := Op(0); op <= OpternUint64x8; op++ {
		kind := DIAG_TABLE[op].auxType
		if seen[kind] {
			continue
		}
		seen[kind] = true
		v := entry.NewValue0I(pos, op, cfg.Types.Int64, -3)
		switch kind {
		case auxNone:
			v.AuxInt = 0
		case auxBool:
			v.AuxInt = 1
		case auxFloat32, auxFloat64:
			v.AuxInt = float64ToAuxInt(1.25)
		case auxString:
			v.Aux = StringToAux("quote\"<&>")
		case auxSym, auxSymOff, auxSymValAndOff:
			v.Aux = &obj.LSym{Name: "symbol"}
		case auxTyp, auxTypSize:
			v.Aux = cfg.Types.Int64
		case auxCall, auxCallOff:
			v.Aux = &AuxCall{Fn: &obj.LSym{Name: "callee"}}
		case auxNameOffsetInt8:
			v.Aux = &AuxNameOffset{Name: name, Offset: 3}
		case auxARM64BitField:
			v.AuxInt = arm64BitFieldToAuxInt(armBFAuxInt(3, 9))
		case auxARM64ConditionalParams:
			v.AuxInt = arm64ConditionalParamsToAuxInt(arm64ConditionalParamsAuxIntWithValue(OpARM64Equal, 5, 7))
		case auxS390XCCMask, auxS390XRotateParams:
			v.Aux = StringToAux("opaque")
		}
		out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("aux:%d:%s:%s:%s", kind, v.auxString(), v.LongString(), v.LongHTML()))
	}
	detached := f.newValueNoBlock(OpConst8, cfg.Types.Int8, pos)
	detached.AuxInt = -1
	out = append(out, "detached:"+detached.LongString(), "nil:"+(*Value)(nil).LongString())
	for _, op := range []Op{OpConst8, OpConst16, OpConst32, OpConst64} {
		v := entry.NewValue0I(pos, op, cfg.Types.Int64, -1)
		out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("unsigned:%s:%x", op, v.AuxUnsigned()))
	}
	// Do not print the raw-formatting probes as a graph: several deliberately
	// have no valid signature or argument list.
	entry.Values = entry.Values[:3]
	var writer snapshotDiagnosticBuffer
	w := &HTMLWriter{w: &writer, Func: f, path: "diagnostic.html"}
	w.start()
	w.WriteSources("source", []*FuncLines{{Filename: "source.go", StartLineno: 2, Lines: []string{"\t", "x < y && z"}}})
	w.WriteAST("AST", bytes.NewBufferString("buildssa F\nfile.go:12:3: x < y\n\n"))
	w.WritePhase("initial", "initial")
	w.WritePhase("same", "same")
	a.AuxInt++
	w.WritePhase("changed", "changed")
	w.flushPhases()
	record("phases", writer.String())
	out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("pending:%d:%d", len(w.pendingPhases), len(w.pendingTitles)))
	// Native Func.Fatalf emits text and pending HTML before forwarding to fe.
	f.HTMLWriter = w
	fe.enabled = true
	func() {
		defer func() { out = append(out, fmt.Sprint("fatal:", recover())) }()
		f.Entry.Fatalf("failure %d", 9)
	}()
	record("fatal-log", fe.log.String())
	record("fatal-html", writer.String())
	saved := writer.String()
	func() { defer func() { out = append(out, fmt.Sprint("value-fatal:", recover())) }(); a.AuxInt8() }()
	out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("value-direct:%t", saved == writer.String()))
	w.Close()
	record("closed", writer.String())
	out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("closed:%t", writer.closed))
	// A deterministic renderer executable exercises the original DOT/process/SVG
	// pipeline. Its output contract is intentionally independent of Graphviz.
	dir := t.TempDir()
	helper := filepath.Join(dir, "renderer")
	dotInput := filepath.Join(dir, "input.dot")
	script := "#!/bin/sh\ncat > '" + strings.ReplaceAll(dotInput, "'", "'\\''") + "'\nprintf '<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\"><g/></svg>'\n"
	if err := os.WriteFile(helper, []byte(script), 0700); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	DIAG_COMMAND
	_ = exec.Command
	dot := &dotWriter{path: helper, phases: map[string]bool{"diagnostic phase": true}}
	f.laidout = true
	entry.Likely = BranchUnlikely
	var svg bytes.Buffer
	dot.writeFuncSVG(&svg, "ignored", f)
	dot.writeFuncSVG(&svg, "diagnostic phase", f)
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(dotInput)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	record("dot", string(raw))
	record("svg", svg.String())
	out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("broken:%t", dot.broken))
	var absent *HTMLWriter
	absent.Close()
	absent.WritePhase("ignored", "ignored")
	data, err := json.Marshal(out)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fmt.Println("SYNCGO_IR=" + string(data))
}
